title: Retrato Editorial de Alta Moda con Doble Exposición: Elegancia Sensual con Vestido Haute Couture
prompt: Create a high-fashion editorial double-exposure image featuring the same woman throughout the composition with strict identity consistency. This is a photorealistic art piece designed for luxury fashion magazines. COMPOSITION: Double exposure layered composite with a large soft luminous close-up face overlay (dominant, dreamy, translucent) on the right side, and a smaller three-quarter-body figure in profile on the left side, crisp and darker toned. Clean studio white background with no text, logos, or watermarks. SUBJECT: The woman has elegant European features with a sophisticated haute couture aesthetic. Makeup is soft glam with glossy lips, subtle smoky eyes, and dewy skin highlight giving a luminous quality. Hair styled in a sleek updo bun with a single loose face-framing strand for editorial sophistication. Hair color is natural chestnut brown. OVERALL MOOD: Sensual, elegant, cinematic editorial suitable for Vogue Paris or Harper's Bazaar, tasteful and artistic not explicit. WARDROBE: Black high-fashion dress - NOT a bodysuit or swimsuit. Options: A) Sleek black satin slip dress with high-cut side opening and draped neckline showing elegant movement, or B) Black halter-neck evening mini dress with an open side cutout but clearly structured as a dress with visible skirt and hemline. The dress must have couture editorial silhouette with tasteful coverage and sophisticated draping. The garment clearly reads as a DRESS with distinguishable skirt/hem structure. POSE: Left figure - profile seated or leaning pose with gracefully arched back, one hand resting elegantly on upper thigh/hip area, shoulders angled forward creating dynamic lines, dress hem and side drape visible, elegant posture conveying movement and sophistication. Right face - close-up with eyes softly closed, lips slightly parted with glossy shine, a fingertip delicately near lips in a very subtle tasteful gesture suggesting contemplation. LIGHTING AND CAMERA: High-end studio lighting with soft key light and smooth gradients. The left figure has slightly higher contrast for definition while the right face overlay is very soft with airy bloom highlights creating a dreamy ethereal quality. Full-frame editorial aesthetic shot with 85mm look for the close-up and 50-85mm for the body layer. Focus: left figure moderately sharp, right face overlay intentionally soft and dreamlike. COLOR AND FINISH: Clean neutral whites with warm skin tones, cinematic contrast, professional color grading. The double-exposure blend uses smooth feathered edges with realistic overlay transparency creating seamless integration, no harsh cut lines. Elegant visual flow between the two layers. TECHNICAL: Ultra-high resolution, photorealistic rendering, editorial fashion photography quality. The composition balances elegance and sensuality in an artistic tasteful manner suitable for luxury European fashion editorial. Single subject only maintaining same facial features and identity throughout. The scene evokes Parisian haute couture sophistication with a touch of Italian cinema glamour.
